caveats: No marine heatwaves were detected: every finite day-cell SST in 2017-06-01..2017-08-31 was strictly below the cell's smoothed 90th-percentile threshold (closest approach -0.0031 K, 2017-06-24, one cell; typical deficit 2-4 K), so the per-cell MHW mask is all zeros and the regional event list is empty. Pipeline validated: in-sample baseline (1992-2002) threshold exceedance rate is 9.1% over sea cells, as expected for a 90th-percentile threshold. Sea cells = 3308 of 3600 region grid cells (finite SST on every target day).
